title: Test vector / plan modulus mismatch in test_ccp16_vectors
description: The ccp16.json test vectors have expected_channel values computed with a channel modulus of 3 (e.g., hash_32=926423932 yields channel=2, matching 1+(926423932%3)=2). However, the test at line 227-233 defaults to EU868 (num_channels=8) when n_channels is not specified in the vector. With EU868, 1+(926423932%8)=5, not 2. This causes the test to fail when run.
close_reason: Fixed test_ccp16_vectors: Changed default n_channels from 8 to 3 to match the oracle used to generate the test vectors. Added logic to create a synthetic 3-channel plan when n_channels is not 8 or 64. Test now passes.
